Optional and caller-owned, and deliberately not derived from the command the way an issue is. Two identical payments — same invoice, amount, method and date, no reference — are an ordinary thing for a customer to do, and a content-derived key would replay the second one away. The caller sends a key only when it means 'this is the same payment I already told you about'.
